# Yanko Design

> Yanko Design is a premier digital publication celebrating innovative product design, industrial design, and creative concepts from global brands and emerging designers.

Yanko Design covers cutting-edge design trends across consumer products, automotive concepts, architecture, and lifestyle innovations. The site features curated design stories, designer profiles, and exclusive partnerships with major brands, serving a design-focused audience interested in the intersection of aesthetics, functionality, and forward-thinking concepts.

## Key Topics

- Product Design
- Industrial Design
- Interior Design
- Design Magazine
- Automotive Design
- Sustainable Design
- Design Concepts
- Brand Collaborations
- Design Innovation
- Architecture
- Editorial Staff
- YD Select Store
- Design Audience
- Sponsorship
- Media Kit
